t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Certain colours score more than others. Every few rounds this may change. Keep an eye out for higher scoring mushrooms like 5+.

vb_textbox.text: Certain colours seem to be better than others. Try to remember what each colour gives (amount of mushrooms). This seems to change every few rounds though so keep an eye out and if any of the colours you are choosing suddenly seem to give a low amount of mushrooms, try to switch to a different colour.
